front: How does an Isolation Forest find anomalies?
back: It splits randomly. Anomalies are alone after few splits, so their path is short and their score is high.

front: scikit-learn score_samples: which sign is abnormal?
back: Lower is more abnormal. Use -score_samples (or decision_function < 0) to rank anomalies.
The difference between a window and its copy rebuilt by a model trained on normal data. A large error means unusual.

front: Name three window features for anomaly models.
back: Mean, standard deviation, range (max − min). Also slope, lag-1 autocorrelation, frequency features.
Windows overlap, so one real event creates many alarms. Count one event once.
